description: This file is a C++ source file implementing low-level CPU-based BLAS and matrix multiplication operations for the PyTorch ATen library. It includes function definitions and dispatch mechanisms for GEMM (general matrix-matrix multiplication), batched GEMM, and related utilities, with support for various data types and hardware acceleration features like oneDNN and MKLDNN.

classes.name: BrgemmKey
classes.description: A key class used for uniquely identifying a batched GEMM operation configuration for caching purposes.

classes.name: PackKey
classes.description: A key class used for caching kernel packs based on tensor dimensions and data types.

classes.name: GemmHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing oneDNN brgemm kernel instances and scratchpads.

classes.name: Brgemm
classes.description: A static class managing batched GEMM kernel caching and execution using oneDNN, with fallbacks.

classes.name: Pack
classes.description: A static class for managing kernel cache and execution of kernel packing for oneDNN.
